snippet.title: I'm turning our Discord game into a multiplayer cat world 🐾
snippet.description:
Meet Minibot World — our Discord factory game is growing into a multiplayer world of cats. 🐾

Customize your cat, make a factory your own, sail the harbour and explore Lantern Mines. Built with my own cat and factory artwork, for our little community.

UPDATE: The free Minibot World beta is now playable! 🐾
Open my channel profile and tap “Play Minibot World” to get started.
Join The White Cat House, then sign in to the game with Discord:
https://discord.com/invite/DSWWqeT6YD

Explore the project: https://minibotworld.com/?source=youtube
Find me live: https://twitch.tv/minimixxy
Support development: https://www.patreon.com/cw/u14271562

In-engine development footage with staged cinematic shots. This is the original reveal trailer. The beta is now open and still in development. Report bugs in #minibot-world-bug-report on Discord.

Music: “A Small Fire Will Do” by Cal McEachern / Trex0n (CC0).
https://opengameart.org/content/a-small-fire-will-do-calming-loop
Recorded ocean audio: jasinski / qubodup (CC0). Foley/interface sounds: Kenney (CC0).
https://opengameart.org/content/beach-ocean-waves
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
https://kenney.nl/assets/interface-sounds

#MinibotWorld #IndieGame #CozyGaming #Shorts #fishing #fishinggame
